examples.text: kva naccaṃ, kva gītaṃ, kva vāditaṃ, kva akkhānaṃ, kva pāṇissaraṃ, kva kumbhathunan'ti, ime kho, gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā samajja-abhicaraṇe

7606.meaning2: related to a higher state of consciousness; concerning a higher state of mind

7608.meaning1: completely covered over (by); hidden (under); totally concealed (by)
7608.commentary: (SNPa) bahun'ābhichanno'ti bahunā rāg'ādikilesajālena abhicchanno. etena ajjhattabandhanaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: satto guhāyaṃ bahunā-abhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.

7609.grammar: opt 3nd sg of abhijāneyya, irreg form of abhijānāsi, trans (+acc)
7609.meaning1: one could know; one may understand
7609.commentary: (NIDD2) vedagū'ti vedo vuccati catūsu maggesu ñāṇaṃ… sabbaṃ vedam'aticca vedagū so'ti. abhijaññā'ti abhijāneyya ājāneyya vijāneyya paṭivijāneyya paṭivijjheyyāti, yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum'ābhijaññā. (SNPa) yaṃ kiñci dhammam'abhijaññā ajjhattan'ti yaṃ kiñci uccākulīnatādikaṃ attano guṇaṃ jāneyya atha vā'pi bahiddhā'ti atha vā bahiddhā'pi ācariy'upajjhāyānaṃ vā guṇaṃ jāneyya.

examples.text: yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum-abhijaññā, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham'imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṅkho.
yaṃ kiñci dhammam'abhijaññā, ajjhattaṃ athavā'pi bahiddhā, na tena thāmaṃ kubbetha, na hi sā nibbuti sataṃ vuttā.
āsīsanti thomayanti abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.

7617.meaning2: mutters prayers to, supplicates; prays for, longs for, covets

7618.commentary: (MNa) abhijappā'ti devalok'ābhimukhaṃ ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā devasaṅghaṃ passato taṇhā udapādi.

examples.text: so'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati, na amanasikāro, na thinamiddhaṃ, na chambhitattaṃ, na uppilaṃ, na duṭṭhullaṃ, na acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ, na atilīnavīriyaṃ, na abhijappā'ti.

7620.meaning1: due to intense longing; because of an aspiration

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi, abhijappā kho me udapādi, abhijapp'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

7627.meaning1: well bred; high born; of noble descent
7627.commentary: (MNa) abhijāto'ti sujāto jātisampanno. (SNa) abhijātan'ti tīṇi kulāni atikkamitvā jātaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti
khattiyaṃ jātisampannaṃ, abhijātaṃ yasassinaṃ, daharo'ti n'āvajāneyya, na naṃ paribhave naro.

7628.commentary: (DNa) chaḷābhijātiyo'ti kaṇh'ābhijāti, nīl'ābhijāti, lohit'ābhijāti, halidd'ābhijāti, sukk'ābhijāti, paramasukk'ābhijātī'ti imā cha abhijātiyo vadati.

examples.text: pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca, dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā, dvaṭṭh'antarakappā, chaḷ-abhijātiyo, aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo, ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate

n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'eva-abhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.
ko sutvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇhā-abhijātiyo, tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna'sāsanan'ti.

7630.meaning1: belonging to a certain social class; of such race
7630.commentary: (DNa) kaṇh'ābhijātiko samāno'ti kaṇhe nīcakule jāto hutvā. (MNa) kaṇh'ābhijātiko'ti caṇḍāl'ādinīcakule jāto.

examples.text: brahmabhūtaṃ atitulaṃ, mārasenappamaddanaṃ, ko disvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇha-abhijātiko.
sace, bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāpa-abhijātikā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
akhettaññunā'ti abhijātipaññattiyā khettaṃ ajānantena.

7632.meaning1: due to social class; because of race

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāp'ābhijātikā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

7634.meaning1: directly knowing; understanding experientially; knowing for oneself

examples.text: ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.
viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbā, abhijānaṃ tathāgato, tiṭṭhantam'enaṃ jānāti, vimuttaṃ tapparāyaṇaṃ.

7635.meaning1: directly knowing; understanding experientially; knowing for oneself

examples.text: n'āhaṃ sahissāmi pamocanāya, kathaṃkathiṃ dhotaka kañci loke, dhammañ'ca seṭṭhaṃ abhijānamāno, evaṃ tuvaṃ ogham'imaṃ taresi.
dvenavute ito kappe, yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ ahaṃ, duggatiṃ na-abhijānāmi, phaladānassidaṃ phalaṃ.

7638.meaning1: directly knows; understands experientially; knows for oneself
7638.commentary: (ANa) abhijānātī'ti aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā'ti ñātapariññāya abhijānāti. (ANa) abhijānāthā'ti abhijānitvā paccakkhaṃ katvā viharatha.

examples.text: so saupaniso samāno abhijānāti ekaṃ dhammaṃ, parijānāti ekaṃ dhammaṃ, pajahati ekaṃ dhammaṃ, sacchikaroti ekaṃ dhammaṃ.
ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti
evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ, abhijānātha me no tumhe, bhikkhave, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ pabhāvitam'etan'ti?
abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, aggivessana, anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā. apissu maṃ ekam'eko evaṃ maññati, mam'ev'ārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī'ti.

7641.meaning1: I clearly remember; I accurately recall

examples.text: abhijānām'ahaṃ, aggivessana, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapetvā dakkhiṇena passena sato sampajāno niddaṃ okkamitā'ti.
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.

7642.meaning2: knew fully; knew by experience; was aware

examples.text: ito satta tato satta, saṃsārāni catuddasa, nivāsam'abhijānissaṃ, devaloke ṭhitā tadā.

7643.meaning1: having directly known; having understood experientially; having known for oneself

7645.synonym: āharati, uppādayati, uppādeti, janeti, nipphādeti, pasavati, pātukaroti, savati
7645.commentary: (DNa) kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyatī'ti kāḷakaṃ dasadussīlyadhammaṃ pasavati karoti. so taṃ abhijāyitvā niraye nibbattati.
7645.notes: pass in construction, but causative in meaning

examples.text: idh'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, addasaṃ bhaṇḍañ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ abhijikañ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ aññam'aññaṃ sutena accāvadante, ehi, bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī'ti.

7647.notes: Kaccāyana (474, 535) takes the root as √har, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jihīrṣati (see MW hṛ). But a more likely candidate is √ji, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jigīṣati (see MW ji).

7648.notes: Kaccāyana (474, 535) takes the root as √har, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jihīrṣati (see MW hṛ). But a more likely candidate is √ji, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jigīṣati (see MW ji).

7649.meaning2: tries to win; wishes to overcome
7649.notes: Kaccāyana (474, 535) takes the root as √har, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jihīrṣati (see MW hṛ). But a more likely candidate is √ji, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jigīṣati (see MW ji).

7650.meaning1: for earning one's livelihood; to support oneself; to live off
7650.commentary: (VINa) abhijīvanikassā'ti yena sippena abhijīvanti, jīvikaṃ kappenti, tassa kāraṇā'ti attho. (VINt) abhijīvanti etenā'ti abhijīvanikaṃ.

examples.text: ime hi nāma, bhikkhave, gihī odātavatthavasanakā abhijīvanikassa sippassa kāraṇā ācariyesu sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharissanti.

7651.meaning2: not breaking; not separating; not damaging

7652.grammar: prp of na bhijjati, neg, pass, intrans
7652.meaning1: not being broken; not breaking (the surface of water)
7652.notes: confusion between water not being broken (passive) and psychic who doesn't break water (active).

examples.text: pathaviyā'pi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi udake, udake'pi abhijjamāno gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pathaviyaṃ, ākāse'pi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi pakkhī sakuṇo
so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigat'ābhijjhena cetasā vihāsiṃ, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
idha, cunda, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhātā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti

7658.meaning1: covetousness and depression; wanting and unhappiness; craving and aversion; greed and distress
7658.commentary: (NP) ātāpī'ti vīriy'indriyaṃ, sampajāno'ti paññ'indriyaṃ, satimā'ti sat'indriyaṃ, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassan'ti samādh'indriyaṃ, evaṃ kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti. kena kāraṇena, ekalakkhaṇattā catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ.

examples.text: yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bālo abyatto akusalo bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.

7660.meaning1: dependent on covetousness; due to wanting

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena abhijjhālu hoti, abhijjhāpaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

7661.meaning1: covetousness and ill-will; greed and hatred

examples.text: aḍḍhateyyavassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu abhijjhābyāpādā vepullam'agamaṃsu.
tattha abhijjhāyati etāyā'ti abhijjhā, parabhaṇḍ'ābhijjhāyana-lakkhaṇassa lobhass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ

7663.synonym: aṭṭhiya, atthika, atthiya, anugiddha, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, chādayamāna, jappanta, jigiṃsanta, jigiṃsāna, jigīsanta, jigīsamāna, jigīsāna

examples.text: dasavassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ek'idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek'idaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā. tattha ye te sattā dubbaṇṇā, te vaṇṇavante satte abhijjhāyantā paresaṃ dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjiṃsu.
kathañ'ca, cunda, tividhaṃ manasā asoceyyaṃ hoti? idha, cunda, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhātā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti
yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno abhijjhālussa abhijjhā appahīnā hoti, byāpannacittassa byāpādo appahīno hoti, kodhanassa kodho appahīno hoti

7666.meaning1: due to the defilement of being covetous and having strong desire for sensual pleasures
7666.sanskrit: abhidhyālu + kāmeṣu + tigma + saṃrāga + saṃdoṣa + hetu

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā abhijjhālū kāmesu tibbasārāgā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, abhijjhālu-kāmesu-tibbasārāga-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

7668.meaning1: accompanied by covetousness; full of greed
7668.commentary: (MNa) saññāpaṭilābhavāre abhijjhāsahagatāya saññāyā'ti-ādīni kāmasaññ'ādīnaṃ dassan'atthaṃ vuttāni. (ANa) abhijjhāsahagatenā'ti taṇhāya sampayuttena.

examples.text: idha, bhante, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti, abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā viharati, byāpādavā hoti, byāpādasahagatena cetasā viharati, vihesavā hoti, vihesāsahagatena cetasā viharati, evarūpaṃ, bhante, cittuppādaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti.
so tena abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā divasaṃ atināmeti. evaṃ kho visākhe, gopālak'uposatho hoti.

7669.commentary: (ANa) abhijjhāvinaye sikkhan'ti abhijjhāvinayo vuccati arahattaṃ, arahatte sikkhamāno appamatto nāma vuccatī'ti sutt'ante vaṭṭaviṭṭaṃ kathetvā gāthāya phalasamāpatti kathitā'ti. (ANt) paṭippassaddhivasena abhijjhā vinaya'ti etenā'ti abhijjhāvinayo, arahattaphalaṃ. ten'āha abhijjhāvinayo vuccati arahattan'ti.

examples.text: abyāpanno sadā sato, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito, abhijjhāvinaye sikkhaṃ, appamatto'ti vuccatī'ti.

7670.commentary: (MNa) sakabhaṇḍe chandarāgo abhijjhā, parabhaṇḍe visamalobho. atha vā sakabhaṇḍe vā parabhaṇḍe vā hotu, yuttapattaṭṭhāne chandarāgo abhijjhā, ayuttāpattaṭṭhāne visamalobho.

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkileso'ti, iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati

7671.meaning1: overcome by covetousness and unsuitable greed; overpowered by greed and immoral desire
7671.commentary: (ANa) visamalobh'ābhibhūtā'ti lobhassa samakālo nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ visamo'va esa. attanā pariggahitavatthumhi pana uppajjamāno samalobho nāma, parapariggahitavatthumhi uppajjamāno'va visamo'ti adhippeto.

examples.text: katamā ca, gahapati, paññāsampadā? abhijjhā-visamalobh'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
idha, cunda, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhitā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti.

7674.meaning1: with direct knowledge; with experiential understanding; with realization

examples.text: catasso imā, bhikkhave, paṭipadā. katamā catasso? dukkhā paṭipadā dandha-abhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippa-abhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandha-abhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippa-abhiññā. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso paṭipadā.
yañ'hi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahā-abhiññataṃ patto'ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahā-abhiññataṃ patto'ti.

7677.meaning1: for the purpose of direct knowledge; for the sake of higher understanding

examples.text: paññā pan'āvuso, kim'atthiyā'ti? paññā kho, āvuso, abhiññ'atthā pariññ'atthā pahān'atthā'ti.

7678.meaning1: having directly known; having understood experientially

examples.text: pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññatvā pathaviṃ mā maññi, pathaviyā mā maññi, pathavito mā maññi, pathaviṃ me'ti mā maññi, pathaviṃ m'ābhinandi.

7679.meaning1: direct knowledge; higher understanding; specialized knowledge
7679.commentary: (DNa) abhiññāya sambodhāyā'ti maggo. (MNa) catunnam'pi saccānaṃ abhiññeyyabhāvadassanato abhiññāya saṃvattati

examples.text: lobhassa ca pahānāya dosassa ca pahānāya atthi majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
yassa kassaci ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ'ca lokaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti
tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.

7682.meaning2: scope of higher understanding from meditation

examples.text: purisasīse kira sibbinī ujukā'va hoti, itthisīse sibbinī vaṅkā hoti, parivattitvā gacchati. so iminā abhiññāṇena idaṃ itthiyā sīsaṃ, idaṃ purisassa sīsan'ti ācikkhi. gāmavāsino'pi rañño pahiṇiṃsu.

yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yā tā rattiyo abhiññātā abhilakkhitā… tathārūpāsu rattīsu yāni tāni ārāmacetiyāni vanacetiyāni rukkhacetiyāni bhiṃsanakāni salomahaṃsāni tathārūpesu sen'āsanesu vihareyyaṃ app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhayabheravaṃ passeyyan'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ
abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ'ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho'smi brāhmaṇa.
amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātā'ti.

7686.commentary: (DNa) abhiññātakolañño'ti pākaṭakulajo. tadā kira jambudīpe ambaṭṭhakulaṃ nāma pākaṭakulam'ahosi. abhiññātassā'ti rūpa-jāti-manta-kulāpadesehi pākaṭassa. (DNt) abhiññātakule jāto abhiññātakolañño.

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, ayaṃ kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo abhiññātakolañño c'eva abhiññātassa ca brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa antevāsī. agaru kho pana bhagavato evarūpehi kulaputtehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hotī'ti.

7687.meaning1: series of higher knowledges; sequence of psychic powers

7688.meaningLit: discourse on abandoning by direct knowledge and complete comprehension

7689.meaning1: should be completely comprehended through experiential understanding; to be fully understood by direct realization

examples.text: sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññāpariññeyyaṃ ….

7690.meaning1: serving as a basis for higher knowledges; acting as a support for psychic powers
7690.commentary: (VINt) abhiññāpādakan'ti abhiññāya patiṭṭhābhūtaṃ. vikubbaniddhiyā eva paṭikkhittattā pathavīcalanaṃ adhiṭṭhahi.

examples.text: tato pādānaṃ samīpe ṭhatvā abhiññ'āpādakaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya, arāsahassapaṭimaṇḍita-cakkalakkhaṇapatiṭṭhitā dasabalassa pādā saddhiṃ kappāsapaṭalehi pañca dussayugasatāni suvaṇṇadoṇiṃ candanacitakañ'ca dvedhā katvā mayhaṃ uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhahantū'ti adhiṭṭhāsi.
so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti
ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.

7692.meaning1: realizable by oneself through direct knowledge; able to be experienced by direct understanding

examples.text: so appamāṇena samādhinā subhāvitena yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.

yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.

7693.meaning1: personally experiencing direct knowledge; intimate experience of higher understanding

examples.text: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi.

7697.meaning1: attained perfection and mastery of experiential understanding; (comm) attained arahantship

examples.text: idh'udāyi, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī… vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati… citte citt'ānupassī viharati… dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.

7698.meaning1: who has attained perfect understanding; who has completely understood

examples.text: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññāvosito muni, sabbavositavosānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

7699.meaning1: should be understood; should be taken; should be interpreted

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, ahu'd'eva kaṅkhā, ahu vicikicchā, kathaṃ nāma samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyo'ti ?

eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
